'''Aldar Beedo's Podracer''' was a [[Podracer/Legends|Podracer]] owned by the [[Glymphid/Legends|Glymphid]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Aldar Beedo/Legends|Aldar Beedo]]. It featured a teardrop shaped [[Cockpit/Legends|cockpit]] and two [[Manta RamAir/Legends|Manta RamAir]] [[Mk IV Flat Twin Turbojet/Legends|''MARK IV'' Flat-Twin Turbojets]].

{{Veh-stub}}

==History==
The Glymphid hitman Beedo [[Podracing/Legends|piloted]] his Podracer during the [[Boonta Eve Classic/Legends|Boonta Eve Classic]] won by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]. Beedo was at the first starting line as the Boonta Eve Classic began, though he fell back in the early portion of the race. Beedo eventually finished third.

==Behind the scenes==
During production of [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']], Aldar Beedo's podracer was known simply as "Podracer A".<ref name="DB-Podracer, Aldar Beedo's">{{DB|vehicle|aldarbeedospodracer|Podracer, Aldar Beedo's}}</ref>
